caption: A power cut hits a restaurant, and every light and the neon sign in the window go dark at once while the candles on the tables keep burning.

sa.check: A restaurant with electric lights on and a neon sign in the window.
Every electric light and the neon sign go dark at once.
The lights and the sign go dark at the same moment.
The order is lit, cut, dark with candles burning.

pc.expect: Every electric light and the sign go dark at the same instant; the candle flames carry on unchanged.
pc.fail: A lamp stays lit after the others are dark; or the sign goes dark before or after the lamps; or the candles go out with the lights; or the candle flames flare or jump at the cut.

pc.expect: The room's contents are the same before and after the cut: the same tables, chairs, candles and lamps in the same places, dark rather than gone.
pc.fail: Candles appear or vanish between lit and dark frames; or tables or chairs appear or vanish; or the sign vanishes rather than going dark; or a lamp changes place.

pc.expect: Once dark, the lights and sign stay dark; if power returns they come back together.
pc.fail: A lamp comes back on alone; or the sign flickers on and off; or the lights return while the sign stays dark to the end; or the candles go out one by one after the cut.

pc.expect: With the lamps dark the room's light comes from the candles: warm pools around each flame and dimness between.
pc.fail: The room stays as bright with every lamp dark; or the candles burn with no glow around them; or light stays pooled under a dark lamp; or the room brightens as the lamps go out.

pc.expect: Tables, chairs, lamps and the sign keep their shapes; nothing passes through a wall or table.
pc.fail: A lamp or the sign changes shape; or a chair merges with a table; or an object passes through a wall; or the candles turn into lamps.

pc.expect: The tablecloths, the walls and the sign's tube colours stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The tablecloths change colour rather than brightness; or the walls change colour; or the sign's lettering changes.

note: People at the tables, if any, are not judged.
